notes.title: 1.2.8.0 -- The Recruit Exam! (Major Update)
notes.notes:
[h2]The Recruit Exam![/h2]
[list]
[*] Running Robot HQ has a notorious in-field exam for prospective recuits who want to earn their Recruit License. 
[*] To attempt the Recruit Exam, one must first complete the Main Branch then find and purchase a special plugin (more info below.)
[*] Speak to Marcus in the Hub world to learn more -- Glory to the Establishment!
[/list]

[h2]Illia's Journals[/h2]
[list]
[*] Personal journals left behind in dungeons by an elusive recruit who joined the Establishment many years ago...
[*] Find Illia's journals to hear her story about how she prepared for and passed the Final Recruit Exam, as well as learn about some other (shadier) things going on at HQ... 
[*] There is a special somebody who is unusually interested in those journals, and willing to ~generously~ pay anybody who collects them all... 
[/list]

[h2]New Areas! (Library, Palace, and Royal Laboratory)[/h2]
[list]
[*] New areas in the Running Robot HQ hub world have been revealed!
[*] You will need to find them to complete your assigned tasks and pass the Recruit Exam.
[/list]

[h2]Software Plugins![/h2]
New abilities purchaseable from Trelarm in the Royal Laboratory!

There are 4 currently available: 
[list]
[*] Gravity Field: Pulls in all surrounding objects of a specified class. Works for rubies by default, until you get Trelarm to upgrade it.
[*] Personal Rally Point (PRP): Place and instantly teleport back to personal rally-points. 
[*] B.L.U.D. (Basic Levitating Unhinged Drone): A flying companion who will give you tips on your journey. B.L.U.D. can also hack doors, and scan people and places to learn more about them. 
[*] Target Disrupter: Spawn a bubble shield which prevents enemies from targeting and shooting you with lasers.
[/list]

[h2]Iceberg Pieces (New collectible)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Found in... ~unusual~ places... 
[*] How deep does it go? Could Nikola's theories have some truth to them? Go talk to him in the hub world to get started.
[/list]

[h2]Marcus Objective Guidance[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Marcus decided to start hanging out in the Dungeons Hub to offer advice on what to do next. Speak to him to have him analyse your personnel report on the Establishment Database (D.E.) and suggest a task!
[/list]

[h2]Other small updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Area Log Achievements: Every important area now has an achievement for finding it. Get exploring!
[*] New achievement info board -- shows what is left to do with traffic lights 
[*] Updates board in-game: Interact to view what's changed since the last update
[*] Dungeon branches now have access restrictions. Recruits must earn rank before gaining access to new dungeon branches. 
[*] Entry requirements to some dungeons -- including single player only, and ruby fees 
[*] Christmas Area! -- can you find it?
[*] Display item name on interact prompt before purchasing from ruby shops 
[*] Button to call elevator!
[*] Removed safety teleporter -- from now on if you fall in the lava you die!  
[*] Bonus rubies straight into your bank at the end of each floor -- proportional to difficulty of dungeon, clamped at 10 per floor 
[*] Eye Watchers accuracy reduced proportional to target characters speed (except Ruby Rider -- bug which I will fix when I have time) 
[*] Chat window automatically opens when using Pasqualdo Central Bank (TM)
[*] Running Robot Man develops a taste for inspecting fine art -- walk in front of a painting in your gallery to admire it 
[*] Cloaks, bodies, paintings, and other achievements now unlock immediately upon collection (you don't need to reload the hub to equip the new cloak you just bought).
[*] Performance improvements to the hub world (introduced level streaming: should be significantly higher FPS).
[*] There is also a strange table in the corner of Central Hall... Says something about a reward for those who leave a Steam review... 
[/list]

Playtesting and bug searching is currently on-going. Expect small updates in the coming weeks.

That's all for now -- have fun!

Jackson, 
Creator of Running Robot Man 4.

notes.title: 1.2.6.0 -- The Museum (+ bug fixes)
notes.notes:
[h1]New content[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Museum -- accessible via the El Skello sky ferry in the hub world. Currently closed for some... *Renovations.*
[/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] New starting rooms in dungeons -- bank only every second floor, and rally point to call teammates 
[*] New gem value scheme. Ruby drops are consolidated into bigger or smaller gems which are worth different amounts. (Rather than spawning 100 gems for a 100 gem drop, there is a gem worth 100 etc.)
[*] Prayer mechanic disabled for remote players for now (bugs)
[*] Lava chasms cube fields should be same on remote and host players (*should*)
[*] New save file system: If there are any issues with missing data let me know
[*] General performance update (might cause issues; let me know) 
[*] Slightly increased number of monsters in Gauntlet Mode. 
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes 
[/h1][list]
[*] Battery not recharging when remote players touch the ground 
[*] Rally points not appearing 
[*] Map geometry not spawning in on remote players until really close 
[*] Death dots not detonating when falling out of sky. Now they shoot like crazy on the way down too. 
[*] Remote players getting stuck above / below elevator when beginning a dungeon (maybe maybe not, idk I guess we will see) 
[/list]

notes.title: New Abilities and Multiplayer Enabled! Version 1.2.2.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Multiplayer enabled! (Experimental! Expect weird behavior and play at your own risk!)
[*] Battery overclocking: Shooting enemies midair gives you extra charges to your battery for using several abilities in one fall. Keep shooting and move like a god. 
[*] Rolling dodges. Press Shift on the ground to roll in any direction.
[*] Nerfed Death Dots: Longer warmup time before they launch their first shot, and their teleport dodge reacts to your aiming slightly slower. 
[*] Stun state on pigs so that you don't get absolutely pummelled if caught in a tight space. 
[*] More invincibility frames after being hit.
[*] Laser charging feedback so you can see who is shooting at you and when they will fire
[*] Ability system bug fixes (i.e. fixed parasol sometimes requiring two button presses to activate if called after a roll etc.) 
[/list]

notes.title: Three New Dungeons! (Version 1.2.1.0)
notes.notes:
There are three new dungeon missions for Stone Chamber Of Eyes, including: 
[list]
[*]Training Mode (a tutorial stage) 
[*]Lava Chasms (platforming over seas of lava while avoiding sniper beams and shooting down monsters)
[*]Soul Spirit Hallways (my favourite -- a spooky dark interior map full of demons)
[/list]

There are many other quality of life changes and bug fixes, including: 
[list]
[*]Ability fixing and tweaking (i.e. Adding more inviniciblity frames for the Safety Teleporter so you are less likely to get quickly killed after being teleported to "safety" after a fall)
[*]Save game update (better readability for achievements left to unlock)
[*]Pasqualdo Central Bank can now accept player defined withdraws and deposits (not just the entire inventory lol)
[*]More information in the tutorial section and on hints in the loading screens (due to feedback about some of the mechanics not being clear!)
[/list]

[h1]IMPORTANT SAVE GAME UPDATE 
[/h1]
[b]All save data will be deleted on the first time you load this version of the game.[/b] All previous save files are incompatible with the new saving system being used and so must be formatted. I apologize if there is anybody who has invested time into their save, but this is the last time this will need to happen! From here on the save game structures are final!

HAVE FUN and LEAVE A REVIEW! I read them all!

Jackson (Slightly Esoteric Studios)

notes.title: Version 1.2.0.0 Early Access!
notes.notes:
A massive overhaul of the entire game and mechanics! I have been working on this update since March 2023 and a lot of things have changed!

Updates include: 

[list]
[*]Dungeon remake! Entirely new floor generation algorithm and 3 modifier challenges to beat (Standard, B-Side, and 100 Trials.)
[*]New AI! Including Splitting Jelly, Killer Piggos, and Death Dot Drones. 
[*]New character abilities! Including the Ruby Rider, Dash, and a redo of the control scheme to make the movement much more fluid and intuitive. 
[*]Many bug fixes -- too many to list lol. 
[/list]

1.2.0.0 is TEMPORARILY ONLY SINGLE PLAYER.. The multiplayer functionality is down for an update that will happen within the next month. I am busy working on a network update which will make the multiplayer movement much smoother. Please be patient, it will be worth it! 

Please let me know your feedback! I love hearing about your experiences and read every comment! 

Also please join the Discord server where you can chat with me and other players. There is a link inside the game hub!

Thanks and have fun!!

Jackson (Slightly Esoteric Studios).
